ch05_openai_builtin_imagegen.note: Codex exec ids are explicitly not provider request ids

ember_volume_recorder.note: model/endpoint are local aliases; backend snapshot unknown. monetary_cost 0 is convention, not an invoice.

reproducibility_limitation.consequence: Many readers and validators reference missing rasters in a clean checkout. Tracked PASS JSON is not live proof that images exist.

rows.current_validation: Linked StoryState / AssetRegistry / SceneBeat / ComicPanelPlan / edition / spatial-contract schema and ID wiring
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Tracked JSON records parse, share story_state_id, declare comic-only plans, spatial_mode in {grounded,cheated,2d_only}, and selected revision hashes match files that exist at validation time.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Narrative quality, identity, that CH02 human review happened, or that later CH05/Ember chapters exist as readable comics.
rows.false_pass_example: CH02 review has human_review_status not_yet_performed while every selected panel assertion value is pass (validate_production_records.py).
rows.false_fail_risk: Missing historical import PNG under a revision path fails the whole CH01/CH02 record set even if the story JSON is intact.

rows.current_validation: CH05CompleteChapterProductionManifest schema, allowlist, service nulls, lettering_safe object, continuity dict, non-promotion flags
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Manifest shape, 50 canonical panel ids, prompt SHA matches prompt_text, references are the three allowlisted hashes, generated art is gitignored, PNG IHDR matches recorded size, unavailable provider fields are null, accepted/commercially_cleared/exact_production_base are false.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: That hair, wardrobe, roles, or lettering-safe zones are true in pixels. lettering_safe.zones is compared to ComicPanelPlan, not to the raster.
rows.false_pass_example: continuity.hair must equal the HAIR constant on every row; a swapped-hair drawing with the copied dict still passes.
rows.false_fail_risk: Clean checkout without experiments/ fails because artifacts must exist. Also fails if a generated PNG is accidentally tracked.

rows.current_validation: PremiumBenchmarkManifest/1.0 plus optional LetteringPlan/2.0 strict editorial
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Required keys, workflow uniqueness, asset hashes if verify_assets, prompt_hash, panel order, scenario enum membership, lettering box geometry, phone_font from font_scale, protected-zone overlap math, action_sequence length, failure/repair wiring.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: That protected_zones cover real faces/hands, that scenario tags match depicted beats, or that rubric numbers came from looking at art.
rows.false_pass_example: author_template assigns REQUIRED_SCENARIOS by index modulo; a blank beat still covers the checklist.
rows.false_fail_risk: verify_assets=True fails in clean checkout when rasters are gitignored; verify_assets=False can PASS a site the reader cannot see.

rows.current_validation: SHA-256 of prompts, references, rasters, SVGs, ledgers, and assembly manifests
rows.what_it_actually_proves: The file on disk is the file named in the record. Repair swaps are byte-exact. Prompt text was not edited after hashing.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Correct subject, seed reproducibility, or that the hashed file is satisfying art.
rows.false_pass_example: A fully wrong but hash-pinned strip crop passes split_ch05_sequence_strips and assembly.
rows.false_fail_risk: Line-ending or PNG recompress changes bytes and fails closed (intended). Clean checkout missing experiments/ fails.

rows.current_validation: Exact SHA-256 collision across Ember sources; CH01 DCT phash Hamming <=6 advisory
rows.what_it_actually_proves: No two Ember selected sources are byte-identical. CH01 near-duplicate phash is reported but not gating (threshold_state UNCALIBRATED_ADVISORY_ONLY).
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: That adjacent panels are distinct shots. Strip siblings and lightly edited retries will not match exact SHA.
rows.false_pass_example: Two panels that differ by a few pixels or crop pass Ember exact-hash. CH01 near-duplicates only advisory.
rows.false_fail_risk: Intentional reused pilot sources would fail Ember if the same file were registered twice; CH01 P001-P016 reuse is path-separated so it does not collide.

rows.current_validation: Lettering boxes must not overlap typed protected_zones; zones required under LetteringPlan/2.0
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Authored lettering rectangles do not intersect authored protected rectangles (plus diagnostic overlay can draw them).
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: That a face, hand, weapon, or injury actually occupies that rectangle. _protected_zones picks among three fractional boxes that miss negative space.
rows.false_pass_example: Face drawn in a lettering slot while face_eyes zone sits on empty mid-panel; collision test still PASS.
rows.false_fail_risk: A correctly placed balloon that overlaps a heuristically chosen unused zone fails strict editorial.

rows.current_validation: Balloon area, total lettering area, balloon count, spoken-word caps, Ember density enum counts
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Authored boxes and word counts stay under numeric caps (or an exception flag is set). Ember volume density dict equals {low:159, moderate:60, high:21}.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Optical density of the drawing, occlusion after SVG expansion, or that low-density panels are visually quiet.
rows.false_pass_example: author_volume.py assigns density from HIGH_ORDERS/MODERATE_ORDERS then audit_volume.py recounts the same labels. Planned-low rendered-busy is only a 25% warn threshold using a failure_class string, not pixels.
rows.false_fail_risk: A readable 29-word climax without lettering_exception fails strict editorial. Ember IoU>0.08 after expansion can fail two honest stacked UI+balloon layouts.

rows.current_validation: font_size * 390 / raster_width >= 13 or 14 (Ember); font_scale * 390 >= 14/12 (premium-rd)
rows.what_it_actually_proves: The authored SVG font-size formula meets a px floor at 390 CSS pixels.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Actual glyph size after wrap/stroke, contrast on the art, or that default Pillow fonts in CH05 overlays are readable.
rows.false_pass_example: Stroke-outlined open text can still vanish on ivory art while phone_type is 14.0. CH05 width/copy sweep uses the same formula on review cards, not shipped lettering.
rows.false_fail_risk: Slightly smaller authored scale on a dense UI block fails despite being the intended hierarchy.

rows.current_validation: SystemStateLedger/2.0 chapter chain, XP thresholds, inventory non-negative, hardcoded final stats
rows.what_it_actually_proves: The Python ledger is internally consistent: chapter N initial == N-1 final, no negative stacks, final level 8 / xp 295 / HP 8/83 / Qi 14/90 / factions / skills match the constants in the same file.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: That any panel's Brass Ledger overlay shows those numbers, or that the story depicts the transaction.
rows.false_pass_example: validate_collection expected dict is authored by run_chapter in the same module; the test cannot catch a jointly wrong story+ledger.
rows.false_fail_risk: A legitimate story change that forgets to edit LEVEL_GROWTH/THRESHOLDS fails closed (useful) but looks like a production incident.

rows.current_validation: irreversible[] flags appended per chapter; consumed items must be quantity 0 at end; class/cultivation history unique
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Named flags were appended and listed consumed items are zero. City pipeline checks state_before == previous state_after string lists.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Visual persistence of scars, broken gear, spent keys, or sealed doors. irreversible() does not prevent later code from granting the same item again unless a later check lists it.
rows.false_pass_example: CH04 records Sable owns Verdigris Seal with no reward; a later panel can still draw the party holding a seal if the prompt forgets it — ledger still PASS.
rows.false_fail_risk: City string-list mismatch on whitespace/order fails a chapter even if the narrative state is equivalent.

rows.current_validation: At least one action_sequence with >=6 panels; CH05 cross-panel gate phrases; Ember ACTION_ORDERS count == 108
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Tags, counts, and required English phrases exist in plans/prompts. Gate contract summary is 8 gates / 13 panels / 15 phrases.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Geography, contact, or aftermath in the drawing. validate_ch05_cross_panel_semantic_gates boundary text says it does not establish visual compliance.
rows.false_pass_example: P036 prompt contains 'one continuous plank visibly connects both adult grips' while agent triage historically WARNed that the path was obscured — prompt gate still PASS.
rows.false_fail_risk: A better rewrite that drops a frozen phrase fails the prompt gate even if the new panel is clearer.

rows.current_validation: Prompt substring contracts for fair/light complexion, hair, wardrobe; CH05 character assertion lint; Phase B hardcoded complexion PASS
rows.what_it_actually_proves: The prompt or JSON contract contains the words. 26 CH05 prompts contain required tokens. Manual atlas records 0 identity inferences.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Rendered complexion, hair color, or role order. compile_ch05_character_assertions_and_prompt_lint.py states this explicitly.
rows.false_pass_example: write_phase_b_audits.py finding 'Elian and Mira remain fair/light-complexioned' is a constant string after review_status check. P036 identity-conflict is handled by a prompt sentence, not a pixel test.
rows.false_fail_risk: A valid prompt rephrase that drops an exact token ('pale oatmeal work coat') fails lint.

rows.current_validation: Entropy/luma/edge/high-frequency on downscaled grayscale; median-filter delta; CLEAN_ART_FAILURES enum
rows.what_it_actually_proves: A 128px or 256px proxy is not nearly blank (Ember entropy>=3.5, luma_std>=12) and optional median-delta / orange-pixel ratios were recorded. Unresolved CLEAN_ART_FAILURES fail the premium bundle.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Line confidence, absence of generic AI texture, or that a 'low' panel is simply composed. City ceilings vs pilot class are the same proxy family.
rows.false_pass_example: _clean_plate blends MedianFilter(3) until median_delta falls, then status REPAIRED. Grainy but narrative-empty splash still beats entropy floor.
rows.false_fail_risk: A correctly quiet low-density panel with large flats can trip entropy/luma floors (Ember) or a clean graphic style can trip City high-frequency ceilings.

rows.current_validation: PremiumRubric/1.0 complete 0-5 scores per criterion, weights sum to 1, winner must match recommendation and beat baseline median
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Every workflow/panel has a full score vector in range, and the selected workflow is the numeric winner among eligible (zero hard_failures) rows.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: That scores correspond to looking at the panel. Tests assign 4.2 vs 3.1 uniformly.
rows.false_pass_example: author_template writes score 0 with evidence AUTHOR REQUIRED; filling 4s everywhere produces a winner without craft review.
rows.false_fail_risk: A human-preferred hybrid that loses median by 0.01 fails the bundle even if weakest-panel is better, unless hard_failures are gamed.

rows.current_validation: HARD_FAILURES set; unresolved OPEN hard failures counted; quality_gate FAIL if unresolved != 0; Ember HARD_FAIL_PRESERVED_DIAGNOSTIC; comic_input_gate fail-closed
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Named classes exist; OPEN members block premium quality_gate; Ember keeps one landscape diagnostic and a retry row; production repair cannot proceed without timed human acceptance and approved base.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: That IDENTITY_FAILURE was visually judged. Empty hard_failures plus REVIEWED_PASS is enough. comic_input_gate has 0 real approved bases, so it never ran on complete-chapter art.
rows.false_pass_example: mark_art_review.py cannot express a per-panel hard fail inside a chapter; everything pending becomes REVIEWED_PASS. Premium tests attach HARD_FAIL_PRESERVED_DIAGNOSTIC to a duplicate asset while the active variant is PASS.
rows.false_fail_risk: Synthetic fixture records are explicitly not approvable (comic_input_gate) — intended. Mis-labeling a limitation as IDENTITY_FAILURE blocks the gate.

rows.current_validation: HTML/SVG href existence; PremiumBuildLedger path/hash/size; Ember volume hrefs
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Premium-rd: every local link resolves and ledger files match sha/bytes. Ember volume: missing review hrefs are warnings, not errors. CH05 owner index: counted links and hashes match the packet.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: That the image decoded as the intended panel, lazy-load worked in a browser, or lettering overlay aligned.
rows.false_pass_example: audit_volume.py writes status PASS with warnings for unresolved local review links. Tracked volume-validation.json has WARN 0 from a raster-present run; clean checkout HTML still 404s experiments/ paths.
rows.false_fail_risk: premium_rd audit_links fails closed on any broken href — correct for a ship gate, noisy if a diagnostic folder is incomplete.

rows.current_validation: Manual Chromium session notes: decoded image counts, no overflow, console empty, a few lettering fixes
rows.what_it_actually_proves: On 2026-09-04, a connected Chrome session at 127.0.0.1:8878 decoded 104/104 phone reader images, reported no horizontal overflow, and recorded four lettering corrections.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Seed reproducibility, license, identity, or that this worktree can repeat the session (rasters gitignored). The doc's own scope note says this.
rows.false_pass_example: 104 healthy images include muddy or identity-drifted plates; decode count cannot fail them.
rows.false_fail_risk: Lazy-load timing or a different viewport could mark incomplete images even if files exist.

rows.current_validation: OwnerApprovalRecord/1.0; per-request owner_approval PENDING; CH05 review.decision cannot be accepted
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Pilot style Candidate B was owner-approved 2026-09-04; commercial_clearance false; volume requests remain owner_approval PENDING; CH05 rows cannot claim accepted true.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Volume or chapter acceptance. Pilot approval is routinely treated as visual lock in prompts ('matching the registered Candidate B anchor').
rows.false_pass_example: A reader seeing owner-approval.json APPROVED may think the 240-panel volume is accepted; generation-requests still PENDING.
rows.false_fail_risk: Validators that require accepted false will fail if an owner later accepts for real unless schemas grow an edition state — intended friction.

rows.current_validation: 11 sequence prompts cover 50 plans; style-line splice; gate phrases appended
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Each arm has 11 sequences, canonical panel_range list, prompt SHA, and three-reference allowlist.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: That a strip contains five separable beats or that crops land on those beats.
rows.false_pass_example: A strip with fused panels still matches prompt SHA and execution hash.
rows.false_fail_risk: Re-wrapping Style/medium without the expected prefix raises ValueError (compiler, not reader).

rows.current_validation: Per-panel exact_prompt + prompt_hash; 224 new requests + 16 pilot reuse + 1 retry
rows.what_it_actually_proves: prompt_hash matches exact_prompt bytes; request count 225; CH01 1-16 skipped as source_reuse.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: That named_subjects() found the right cast (substring of beat), or that camera modulo is a useful shot.
rows.false_pass_example: A beat that says 'the party' expands CHAPTER_CAST; a beat that says 'he' without Elian may omit the subject contract (CH01 P018 prompt in generation-requests.json has empty subject_contract).
rows.false_fail_risk: Editing a prompt without updating stored hash fails audit (intended).

rows.current_validation: CH05 three-hash allowlist; Ember four-id cap; G07 two public controls
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Only listed hashes may be uploaded/attached. BFL stays fictional-controls-only. Ledger r37: 92 uses / 3 unique CH05 hashes.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Identity lock. P036 is known conflicting and is still in the allowlist as composition-only.
rows.false_pass_example: Every complete-chapter panel may attach P050/P040/P036; validator only checks membership in ALLOWLIST.
rows.false_fail_risk: A new better identity sheet with a new hash is rejected until ALLOWLIST is edited (fail-closed, good) but encourages over-reuse of the three files.

rows.current_validation: baseline_legacy records, model inventory hashes, Comfy availability, Stage-A 24-case wrapper
rows.what_it_actually_proves: If ComfyUI and garden/ exist, a request/attempt pair can be recorded with seeds, LoRA list, and output SHA. sequential_inpaint measures collateral change, not quality.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Regional LoRA isolation (gen3.py states LoRAs are global). This worktree cannot run the path (garden/ and ComfyUI/ absent).
rows.false_pass_example: Dry-run writes status planned without generating art. Historical 24/24 Stage A completions with 0 accepted still look like a finished benchmark in GOAL.md.
rows.false_fail_risk: assert_comfy_available fails if 127.0.0.1:8188 is down — expected, but easy to confuse with renderer-quality failure.

rows.current_validation: Copy from Codex generated_images or local path; refuse overwrite; record null service fields
rows.what_it_actually_proves: A PNG was ingested to a planned path with measured elapsed (CH05) or elapsed_seconds (Ember), dimensions, and hash. CH05 refuses to clobber different bytes.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Provider model, seed, cost, or that the image matches the prompt. Ember labels model imagegen-default.
rows.false_pass_example: Registering a wrong PNG that happens to be the planned destination's first copy is permanent; no visual check.
rows.false_fail_risk: Source outside ~/.codex/generated_images is rejected (CH05) even for a legitimate local replay.

rows.current_validation: Bright/dark row clusters must equal panel_count-1; hash-pinned boxes; optional MANUAL_GUTTER_OVERRIDES
rows.what_it_actually_proves: The detector found the expected number of near-white or near-black bars, or a pinned override was used (flat-gouache: 1).
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: That each crop is one story beat. Fused drawings with a white bar still crop.
rows.false_pass_example: A model that paints decorative white gutters to match the prompt's implied strip layout satisfies the detector.
rows.false_fail_risk: A good strip without high-contrast bars raises expected N-1 gutters, blocking the arm until a manual override is added.

rows.current_validation: Non-gating CH05 agent triage PASS/WARN table
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Assembly panel ids match plans; warning dict applied; fail count is always 0; human_reviewed 0.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Role binding, hair, lettering clearance, or phone readability. Those checks are constants.
rows.false_pass_example: r6 sets repaired_pass_count=7 and leaves only P032 WARN by deleting keys from WARNINGS, not by re-inspecting pixels.
rows.false_fail_risk: None for FAIL (unreachable). Mis-keyed panel_id silently PASSes.

rows.current_validation: Chapter batch mark REVIEWED_PASS
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Exactly 24 (or 8 for ch01 remainder) rows were GENERATED_PENDING_REVIEW and are now REVIEWED_PASS with one notes string.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Per-panel inspection. Mixed quality cannot be represented.
rows.false_pass_example: audit_volume.py then requires review_status in {REVIEWED_PASS, HARD_FAIL_PRESERVED_DIAGNOSTIC}; the batch flip satisfies it.
rows.false_fail_risk: A chapter with 23 pending + 1 unexpected status aborts the whole mark.

rows.current_validation: Targeted repair manifest replaces N assembly sources by hash
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Named panels were replaced with files whose hash/dimensions match the repair record; other entries untouched in the written assembly.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: The repair_class is visually true, or that unchanged panels were re-checked.
rows.false_pass_example: Replacing P001 with any  hash-matching PNG labeled departure_vector compiles r2.
rows.false_fail_risk: Source assembly hash mismatch fail-closed if someone reformats JSON (intended).

rows.current_validation: Preserve landscape hard fail; insert tall retry; snapshot non-targets
rows.what_it_actually_proves: CH03 P007 r1 is diagnostic non_vertical_source; r2 is a different request; other outputs' hashes unchanged if files exist.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: The retry is the same story moment or a better drawing — only that it is taller than wide if it later passes the dimension check.
rows.false_pass_example: A tall but unrelated image at p007.png plus unchanged neighbors PASSes repair-validation.json.
rows.false_fail_risk: verify_repair_snapshot fails in clean checkout because non-target paths are under experiments/.

rows.current_validation: Scale-aware boundary selector, topology, exterior-zero, lettering-zero, 16px/5px profiles
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Abstract mask math on synthetic/control images: exterior and lettering pixels unchanged; selected widths meet predeclared numeric rules. Real P036 still blocked (no approved base/mask/authority/reservation).
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Seam quality on story art. ADR text already limits this to mechanics.
rows.false_pass_example: 0% exterior change on a rectangular control is not an acceptable seam (GOAL.md records this).
rows.false_fail_risk: Topology tests on disconnected/holed controls do not apply as production profiles (explicitly non-profile).

rows.current_validation: Lettering SVG built from units; overflow grows the box toward mid-frame
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Given a source PNG size, overlay SVG is a pure function of units. HTML layers overlay separately from art.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: No occlusion of faces after expansion. Missing PNG still yields well-formed SVG.
rows.false_pass_example: Needed height > authored box expands into the focal half; audit then uses effective_box so fit PASSes.
rows.false_fail_risk: Contact sheet / render_svg raise if source missing — live build fails; tracked HTML remains.

rows.current_validation: Tracked VolumeValidation/1.0 PASS, 224/1, 0 errors
rows.what_it_actually_proves: A past run on a machine with rasters reported PASS. JSON is internally consistent with that claim.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: That this checkout can show 240 panels. experiments/ is gitignored and absent here.
rows.false_pass_example: Git status clean + volume-validation.json PASS while HTML img src points at missing experiments/reimaginings/ember-lattice/volume/ch01/source/p017.png.
rows.false_fail_risk: Re-running audit_volume.py now would FAIL on missing sources — the live tool is harsher than the tracked snapshot.

rows.current_validation: Four markdown audits with hardcoded PASS findings
rows.what_it_actually_proves: All generation-requests are REVIEWED_PASS or diagnostic; density/action totals can be summed from dialogue-and-density-metrics.json.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Complexion, fight causality, eye-strain, or phone occlusion. Those lines are string literals.
rows.false_pass_example: Finding 'PASS — Elian and Mira remain fair/light-complexioned...' is not computed from pixels.
rows.false_fail_risk: Any request not yet batch-marked blocks the whole Phase B packet.

rows.current_validation: Pinned core suite N/N plus extension validators; mutation rejection; $0 activity
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Listed local scripts still exit 0 and the gate JSON still matches. Network/provider/upload/cost fields remain zero in the gate record.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Art, identity, or that CH05 is executable. Boundaries array already says passing does not create human review or acceptance.
rows.false_pass_example: 44 core + 8 extensions = 52/52 while GOAL.md records 0/50 accepted and 0/20 G07 human decisions.
rows.false_fail_risk: stdout last-line identity and check-count pinning fail if a validator prints an extra warning — process fragility, not reader value.

rows.current_validation: ch05-production-cost-ledger r1 through r37 each with a validator
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Append-only accounting: this revision added two local zero-cost milestones; committed USD still 0.000000; human minutes null.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Built-in ImageGen is free (monetary_cost_usd is null). Production fitness. 124 local milestones are not 124 reader improvements.
rows.false_pass_example: Appending ch05_overnight_closeout_release_r1 with external_cost_usd 0.000000 is a documentation event scored as ledger health.
rows.false_fail_risk: Editing r36 bytes breaks the supersedes hash chain (intended for forensics, costly for maintainers).

rows.current_validation: Base raster / mask approval, timed minutes, journal chain, budget binding, RenderRecord v2
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Illegal transitions, hash tampers, missing minutes, synthetic fixtures, and unknown provider outcomes cannot be promoted. Strong crash-safety for paid submit.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Any real CH05 panel used this path (approved bases 0). Does not improve ImageGen quality.
rows.false_pass_example: A full synthetic lifecycle can PASS validators in fixture mode while real ledgers stay BASE_APPROVAL_PENDING.
rows.false_fail_risk: High — by design. Missing human_minutes blocks approval.

rows.current_validation: 16 candidates, 20 timed decisions required, provider-hidden packets, fail-closed rollup
rows.what_it_actually_proves: Packet hashes, no identity leak in presentation, 0/20 decisions, null minutes, candidates unaccepted. Vault pins 19 provider records + 16 candidates if local bytes exist.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Which renderer is better for a serial. Human arm results remain null (ADR-0039).
rows.false_pass_example: Engineering closeout can be 12/12 complete while G07 stays 0/20 (GOAL.md / ADR-0082).
rows.false_fail_risk: Vault validator fails without ignored local archive — same experiments/ limitation.

rows.current_validation: Unique ids, reading order, asset hashes, uncalibrated phash, not_assessable balloons

rows.what_it_does_not_prove: Lettering, identity, set continuity.

rows.false_fail_risk: Missing accepted_asset file fails (correct).

rows.what_it_actually_proves: A future graph schema forbids prompt/output/provider keys and requires continuity categories on a fixture.
rows.what_it_does_not_prove: That CH05's real 50 plans satisfy a live semantic graph of footprints/tin/map (those are separate phrase gates).

rows.what_it_actually_proves: Compiled JSON counts and hashes. Silence rows have no text. Safe-zone boxes are well-formed.
